# Pi-family CLI fixtures

Captured 2026-09-10 using only `--help` and `--version`; no credentials read, model requests, or configuration writes. Help files contain verbatim relevant line excerpts, not complete help outputs.

- `omp-18.0.11-*`: `/Users/w/.local/bin/omp`; reports `omp/18.0.11`. Local upstream source `/Users/w/Projects/easy-pi/oh-my-pi`, package `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent`. `packages/coding-agent/src/session/session-entries.ts` exports `CURRENT_SESSION_VERSION = 3`; session-manager.ts `#setSessionFile` adopts a valid header and `static open` takes an exact path. `src/main.ts:createSessionManager` forwards `--resume <path>` to SessionManager.open. `src/config/settings-schema.ts` approval mode values: always-ask, write, yolo; default yolo. Native mode leaves this user/native default unchanged. `packages/utils/src/dirs.ts` states an explicitly empty OMP_PROFILE selects default rather than inherited PI_PROFILE.
- `easy-pi-0.84.2-*`: PATH `/Users/w/.local/share/fnm/node-versions/v24.15.0/installation/bin/pi` and `node /Users/w/Projects/easy-pi/pi/packages/coding-agent/dist/cli.js` produced identical help and version. The command and npm package name remain upstream Pi, but help starts `easy-pi -` and names `EASY_PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`. `src/core/product-identity.ts` gives easy-pi its `.epi` root and EASY_PI_* overrides; config.ts resolves ~/.epi/agent with no legacy data fallback. `src/main.ts` resolves --session-id by exact ID and creates if absent, whereas --session accepts a saved file. `src/extensions/easy-pi.ts` provides native /permissions and @easy-pi/permissions, with full-access initial mode; no tool-permission CLI flag is exposed. --approve/--no-approve are project trust only and must not be mapped to tool approval.

Private AgentPort session storage uses `<session_dir>/omp` and `<session_dir>/easy_pi`, not the existing legacy Pi migration namespace. Configuration stays in the respective native ~/.omp/agent and ~/.epi/agent directories. Cold resume requires a regular existing JSONL with matching full UUID, cwd and supported header version; missing conversations are blocked rather than recreated.

Relevant easy-pi documentation read in full: packages/coding-agent/README.md, docs/environment-variables.md, docs/session-format.md, docs/terminal-setup.md. README/session-format retain some upstream `.pi` wording; current help, environment-variables.md and product-identity.ts consistently prove `.epi`, which is also the user-confirmed requirement.
